question: I am an active member ordering an ordinary 45-dollar jacket to a contiguous-US address. If I choose standard delivery, what does shipping cost? If I choose express on Monday at 14:00 Eastern in a week without holidays, what does it cost and what is the transit target? Assume no payment or address issue.

input.query: express delivery eligibility ordinary parcels lithium oversize

evidence.text: Express order processing  Express delivery for eligible ordinary parcels costs USD 18. It has a two-business-day transit target after dispatch. Orders accepted before 13:00 Eastern Time on a business day are dispatched that day. Orders accepted at or after 13:00, or on a weekend, are dispatched on the next business day. Business days for this policy are Monday through Friday excluding published holidays.  The transit clock starts after dispatch, not when the customer adds an item to the basket. For an eligible order placed on a Monday at 14:00 during a week with no holidays, dispatch is Tuesday and the two-business-day transit target is Thursday. Payment review or an address problem can prevent dispatch until the issue is resolved. Do not infer that a particular order cleared those checks from this policy alone.  Some product categories cannot use express delivery. Check the lithium-delivery and oversize-delivery articles before promising this service.

Check the lithium-delivery and oversize-delivery articles before promising this service. A customer cannot pay a surcharge to remove a product restriction. The membership benefit covers qualifying standard delivery only. It does not discount the USD 18 express price or change the cutoff time.

Delivery restrictions for rechargeable products  Products containing lithium batteries travel by ground service within the contiguous United States. The rule covers rechargeable lanterns, headlamps, power banks, and navigation devices, including products whose batteries are installed inside the equipment. These products cannot be sent by our air services, to Alaska or Hawaii, or to an international destination.  Selecting express shipping at checkout does not override this restriction. If a mixed order includes an ordinary item and a rechargeable device, the rechargeable item still travels by ground. A support agent must not promise that paying the express surcharge makes a battery shipment eligible for air transport. The customer can remove the battery product and place a separate order for the other items if those items qualify for the requested service.  Ground shipping has the delivery estimate shown at checkout for the destination. This policy does not supply a guaranteed arrival date for a particular parcel. Tracking events come from the carrier after dispatch.

chunks.text: Standard delivery prices  For ordinary parcels to the contiguous United States, standard ground delivery costs USD 6 when the qualifying merchandise subtotal is below USD 75. At USD 75 or more, standard delivery is free. The qualifying subtotal is calculated after discounts and before sales tax. Gift cards do not count toward it. A basket that was above the threshold before a discount may fall below it afterward.  An active store membership reduces the free standard-delivery threshold to USD 40. The membership must be active when the order is placed. Becoming a member later does not retroactively refund an earlier delivery charge. Membership is linked to the purchasing customer, not automatically to everyone at the same address.  Oversize products have a separate delivery charge and do not receive free delivery under either threshold. The oversize-delivery article explains the fee. Express service has its own price and restrictions; free standard delivery does not mean free express delivery.

Express order processing  Express delivery for eligible ordinary parcels costs USD 18. It has a two-business-day transit target after dispatch. Orders accepted before 13:00 Eastern Time on a business day are dispatched that day. Orders accepted at or after 13:00, or on a weekend, are dispatched on the next business day. Business days for this policy are Monday through Friday excluding published holidays.  The transit clock starts after dispatch, not when the customer adds an item to the basket. For an eligible order placed on a Monday at 14:00 during a week with no holidays, dispatch is Tuesday and the two-business-day transit target is Thursday. Payment review or an address problem can prevent dispatch until the issue is resolved. Do not infer that a particular order cleared those checks from this policy alone.  Some product categories cannot use express delivery. Check the lithium-delivery and oversize-delivery articles before promising this service.

Express service has its own price and restrictions; free standard delivery does not mean free express delivery. Any original outbound shipping charge remains separate from the item price when the customer later makes a change-of-mind return. The checkout presents the final delivery options before payment.
